resources.string: For older NAS devices without SMB3 encryption. Others on your network could see the files you play; signing still stops them being altered.
Play files from this device, a USB drive, or a network folder. Select several files to create a queue.
SMB3 (encrypted): smb://server/share · SFTP: sftp://server/folder\nWebDAV: https://server/folder · FTPS: ftps://server/folder\nPlain FTP and HTTP do not encrypt network traffic.
